title: Closing the Affective Loop: Multimodal Speaker-Listener Emotion-Dynamics-Aware Empathetic Social Robots

extra.description: Empathetic social robots should respond not only to what users say, but also to how their emotions dynamically evolve during interaction. However, existing empathetic dialogue systems are often text-centered and primarily model empathy as a one-way mapping from the user's emotion to the system response, limiting their ability to capture embodied speaker--listener affective exchange.
